instructions: Read ANTIGRAVITY_BRIDGE.md from origin/agent-control before execution.
Fetch the task-004 working branch and verify exact code.base_sha.
Create antigravity/prima-20260921-005 from the exact base SHA.
Keep the task-004 evidence panel concept as a review aid, but improve it for radiologist use before any merge.

For each positive diagnosis, allow up to three clinically distinct preferred sequence families rather than only the single highest-ranked series. Example ischemia: DWI + ADC + FLAIR; hemorrhage: SWI/SWAN/T2* + FLAIR; tumor: post-contrast T1 + FLAIR/T2 + DWI when available.
Do not show arbitrary fallback series for diagnoses whose preferred evidence sequence is absent. It is better to say no suitable review series found than to show a misleading T2 image.

Add diagnosis-specific overrides where group-level mapping is insufficient. At minimum review Moyamoya, aneurysm, AVM/cavernoma, sellar lesions, ventriculomegaly, atrophy, small-vessel disease, and postoperative findings.
Standardize loaded DICOM volumes to a consistent LPS orientation before thumbnail extraction when SimpleITK permits it.
Make the thumbnail display explicitly radiological: patient Right on image left and patient Left on image right, with visible R/L markers. Add orientation/slice labels without burning PHI.
Make thumbnails clickable to open a larger local image. Keep the HTML fully offline.
Deduplicate identical series/slice thumbnails across labels where practical while preserving per-label recommended sequences.
Keep the main wording as 'ảnh gợi ý rà lại' / 'lát cắt tiêu biểu'; do not imply model localization or proof.
Add synthetic tests for multi-series selection, no-misleading-fallback behavior, LPS orientation handling, R/L annotation, deduplication, and safe clickable relative paths.
Re-render CASE001 locally using existing predictions and staged DICOM; do not rerun PRIMA inference.
Verify the report remains readable when several labels share the same preferred series.
Push only code/tests to GitHub. Patient thumbnails/report/DICOM/series descriptions remain local only.

acceptance: A new working branch antigravity/prima-20260921-005 is created
Evidence panels can show multiple clinically distinct preferred sequences per positive label
Missing preferred sequences do not trigger misleading generic fallback thumbnails
DICOM thumbnail extraction uses consistent orientation and visible R/L markers
Thumbnails are clickable through safe relative local paths
CASE001 is re-rendered locally without rerunning PRIMA inference
No patient-derived data or local series names are pushed to GitHub
A terminal result is pushed to .antigravity/results/PRIMA-20260921-005.json
